name: Field
description:
The Field component labels a form control and connects it to its helper text and error text, wiring the ids and ARIA attributes for you. It is composed of several primitives that enable customization and flexibility in its usage.

Use the default `<Field>` with a `label`, `helperText` and `errorText` around a control: `Field.InputGroup` (also available as `Input`) renders an input with optional `startIcon`/`endIcon` and the Cerberus invalid icon, and `Field.Textarea` (also available as `Textarea`) a textarea. Mark it `invalid` to swap the helper text for the error text, `required` to show the required indicator, and set the `size` on the field (or on a single `Field.InputGroup`). Compose the primitives for full structural control.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction of the root that renders the label with its required indicator, the control, and the helper text, error text and secondary helper text

props.name: label
props.description: The label of the field.

props.name: helperText
props.description: The helper text of the field. Hidden when the field is invalid.

props.name: secondaryHelperText
props.description: A helper text positioned at the end of the field. Good for Textarea fields.

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error text of the field. Shown when the field is invalid.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Whether to hide the label visually while keeping it accessible to screen readers. On a `Field.Label` primitive, use the `srOnly` style prop.

parts.name: InputGroup
parts.description: An abstraction that renders the input root with an optional start indicator, the input, and the Cerberus invalid icon or an end indicator

props.name: size
props.description: The size of this input. Defaults to the `size` of the parent `Field`.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: An optional icon to display at the start of the input.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: An optional icon to display at the end of the input while the field is valid. The Cerberus `invalid` icon replaces it when the field is invalid.

parts.name: StatusIndicatorWithIcon
parts.description: An abstraction that renders the status indicator with the Cerberus `invalid` icon when the field is invalid, else an end indicator with its `fallback`

props.name: fallback
props.description: The content of the end indicator rendered while the field is valid.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: css

parts.description: Exposes the Field state to a render function. Renders no element.

notes: `Field.Root` renders a `role="group"` element and `Field.Label` a native `label` whose `for` points at the control.
The control gets `aria-invalid` when the field is invalid, and `aria-describedby` pointing at the helper text and, when invalid, the error text.
The error text is a polite live region, and the required indicator is hidden from assistive technology since the control is marked `required`.
The start, end and status indicators of `Field.InputGroup` are decorative (`aria-hidden`); describe anything they convey in the label or helper text.
